# Shopify stores 爬虫

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/shopify-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/shopify-scraper.md)

示例爬虫，用于收集来自 Shopify 店铺的商品数据，使用 Python 和 [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) 网页抓取 API 编写。属于 [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.zh-CN.md) 项目。

- **指南:** [How to Scrape Shopify Stores for Products, Prices, and Variants](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-shopify-stores)
- **代码:** [`shopify.py`](shopify.py) · **示例运行:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **测试:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **示例输出:** [Storefront preflight](results/preflight.json) · [Catalog products.json](results/catalog.json) · [Collection products](results/collection.json) · [Product pages](results/product_pages.json) · [Sitemap product urls](results/product_urls.json)

## 抓取内容

- Shopify 店铺预检，对店铺 `/products.json` 的响应进行分类
- 来自 `/products.json` 的 Shopify 商品目录页，包含商品、价格和嵌套的变体
- 来自 `/collections/<handle>/products.json` 的 Shopify 商品集合中的商品
- Shopify 商品页面，读取其 JSON-LD `Product` 和 `ProductGroup` 数据
- 从店铺站点地图索引获取 Shopify 商品 URL

## 函数

- `scrape_catalog(store_url, max_pages=2, limit=CATALOG_PAGE_SIZE, collection=None)` → `List[ShopifyProduct]`: scrape products from a Shopify storefront products.json route
- `scrape_collection(store_url, collection, max_pages=2, limit=CATALOG_PAGE_SIZE)` → `List[ShopifyProduct]`: scrape products of a single Shopify collection, keeping the merchandising context
- `scrape_product_pages(urls)` → `List[ShopifyProductPage]`: scrape Shopify product pages, the fallback when the catalog JSON route is unusable
- `scrape_product_urls(store_url, max_sitemaps=1)` → `List[str]`: discover product URLs from the Shopify sitemap index

这些函数是 `async` 函数：请使用 `asyncio.run(...)` 运行，或使用 `await` 调用。

### 示例

输入参数取自 [`run.py`](run.py) 中的示例（较长的列表已截短）：

```python
import asyncio
import shopify


async def main():
    catalog = await shopify.scrape_catalog(store_url="https://www.allbirds.com", max_pages=2, limit=20)
    collection = await shopify.scrape_collection(
        store_url="https://www.deathwishcoffee.com",
        collection="coffee",
        max_pages=1,
        limit=20,
    )
    product_pages = await shopify.scrape_product_pages(
        urls=[
            "https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-strider-medium-grey",
            "https://www.deathwishcoffee.com/products/vanilla-10oz",
        ],
    )
    product_urls = await shopify.scrape_product_urls(store_url="https://www.allbirds.com")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## 输出

这些函数返回普通的字典和列表。字段：

- **`ShopifyVariant`**: `variant_id`, `title?`, `sku?`, `options`, `price?`, `compare_at_price?`, `available?`
- **`ShopifyProduct`**: `product_id`, `handle`, `url`, `title?`, `vendor?`, `product_type?`, `description?`, `tags`, `options`, `images`, `variants`, `price_min?`, `price_max?`, `published_at?`, `updated_at?`
- **`ShopifyPreflight`**: `store_url`, `catalog_url`, `status_code`, `content_type?`, `outcome`, `product_count?`, `is_shopify_catalog`
- **`ShopifyOffer`**: `sku?`, `title?`, `price?`, `currency?`, `availability?`, `url?`
- **`ShopifyProductPage`**: `url`, `schema_type?`, `product_id?`, `name?`, `brand?`, `sku?`, `description?`, `images`, `price?`, `currency?`, `availability?`, `offers`, `variant_urls`

标有 `?` 的字段可能为 `null`。

## Scrapfly 设置

[`shopify.py`](shopify.py) 中的 `BASE_CONFIG` 保存请求的默认设置，参见 [Scrape API 文档](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started)：

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly 的 [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)，即其反机器人绕过功能
- `country` = `"US"`: 代理所在国家

## 说明

每个路由都取决于具体店铺，因此在假定某个店铺提供商品目录 JSON 之前，请先运行预检。

## 快速开始

需要 Python 3.10 及以上版本和 [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation)。

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/shopify-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # 获取地址： https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # 示例抓取，结果保存在 ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # 运行该爬虫的测试
```

测试：`test_preflight_scraping`, `test_catalog_scraping`, `test_collection_scraping`, `test_product_page_scraping`, `test_product_urls_scraping`；使用 `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>` 运行单个测试。 `run.py` 和测试会抓取真实网站，因此会消耗 Scrapfly 积分。
